intro: After Tok'Kar sends you to speak with Katar, Katar makes plain a hatred of the sea. Watching the fish men die at the hands of anyone who does the Horde's will gives Katar some pleasure, and Katar asks how many you can slay and whether you would test yourself against their strongest kind.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have no love for the sea, nor any creature I've seen come from its depths. It is a powerful but blind mistress; callous and brutal. It would bring me great pleasure to slay the fish men by the hundreds if it were within my power. But I garner some pleasure from watching their deaths at the hands of any who do the Horde's will.
Which brings us to you, adventurer. How many can you slay? Would you test yourself against their most powerful kind?

clips.title: Progress
paras: I am patient. Patient and everlasting like an old kank stone from Draenor. The fish men shall not make it past our borders--not while I still stand. If we had an army at our disposal I would cleanse this world and all others of their presence. I feel my hatred seethe just speaking about them.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The sea seems vast and relentless, but you have stained her with the blood of her own spawn. The fish men know pain. Their stupidity will force them to refortify their ranks from the devastation you've caused, and that is good.
Let their gurgling screams overshadow the sea's roar long into the night. I shall smile every time I hear one of them silenced.
Return to me if you wish to slay more of the fish men. I will gladly reward you again.
